opportunities.name: Trip.com attractions search with sorting and opening a result
opportunities.description: On Trip.com, search Attractions & Tickets for a {destination} and {keyword}, sort results by {sort_order}, and open an attraction's detail page.
steps: Click the 'Attractions & Tickets' tab or nav link
Click the Destination field and type or select {destination} from the dropdown
Click the Keywords field and type {keyword}
On the results page, click the sort option {sort_order} (Top Rated / Lowest Price)
Click the attraction result {result_choice} to open its detail page
